Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to address some concerns that have been brought to our attention regarding your recent behavior in the workplace. Specifically, we have received multiple complaints indicating that your conduct has not aligned with our company’s values and professional standards.

We value a respectful and collaborative work environment for everyone, and it is important that we all contribute to maintaining this culture. We expect an immediate improvement in your behavior and full adherence to our professional guidelines moving forward.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss this further or if there are any underlying issues we can help address. We are committed to supporting you in making the necessary adjustments.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

***

The animal known for its long neck is the giraffe.
